sqlMap.update: MERGE INTO EAI.IF_GS_USER A USING ( SELECT #EMP_NO# AS EMP_NO, #DEPT_CODE# AS DEPT_CODE FROM DUAL ) B ON (1 = 1 AND A.EMP_NO = B.EMP_NO ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET DEPT_CODE = B.DEPT_CODE, USE_CHK = 'Y', UPDATE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( COM_CODE,EMP_NO,DEPT_CODE,USE_CHK,UPDATE_DATE ) VALUES ( 'KRGSEP0001', #EMP_NO#, #DEPT_CODE#, 'Y', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') )
UPDATE EAI.IF_GS_USER SET USE_CHK = 'N' WHERE UPDATE_DATE <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-2, 'YYYYMMDD')
